entities.description: The 1st decan of Aries spans 0–10° of the tropical zodiac. Ruled by Mars in the Chaldean decan system, it carries the combined qualities of Aries and Mars's influence. In the Thoth tarot system developed by Aleister Crowley and Lady Frieda Harris, this decan corresponds to the 2 of Wands — Dominion — whose imagery reflects the psychological and elemental qualities of this ten-degree arc. The decans originate in ancient Egyptian astrology, where each was associated with a decan-star (star group) rising heliacally during that period; Hellenistic astrologers later merged them with the Chaldean planetary sequence.
